name: Airscope
tagline: Wi-Fi analyzer: nearby networks, channel graphs, live signal and a dead-zone walk test.
description: Airscope shows every Wi-Fi network around you with band, channel, signal strength, security and Wi-Fi standard. See how crowded each channel is, get a best-channel recommendation for your router, watch your connection live, and walk through your home to find weak spots. Everything runs on your phone, with no ads and no tracking.
